grounding.note: to_canonical_json is the ONE place a ProjectModel becomes its stored JSON bytes (C3 also defines and loads the type); the file-write call sites live in C6/C8, but the serialization C3 owns is what makes it the format's system of record.
assemble builds the model itself (ProjectModel() at assemble.py:159) and writes project-map.json at the anchored line.
the anchored line constructs Edge(...) and appends it to m.edges — a real creation of the Edge type in C6's own code.
fix.py (a C8 file) mutates the loaded ProjectModel tree and writes the map back to disk at the anchored line.

C8 writes reconcile.json here and is also the only reader (load_reconcile → Reconcile in reconcile.py), so it owns the record; caveat: the payload written is a plain dict, the Reconcile dataclass is built only on the load side.
iter_source_files constructs and returns WalkResult at the anchored line — 'emits' here means produce-and-return to callers, not a bus publish.

the anchor (preindex_lib.py:277) only constructs Symbol; the real persistence is C9's build_symbols serializing every Symbol field into the symbols/by_name+extents block written to preindex.json at preindex.py:432, and read back by --report, serve and the impact engine.
the anchor (preindex_lib.py:294) only constructs ImportRef; C9 serializes its file/line/module into the imports block written to preindex.json at preindex.py:432.

DirExpectation is only built in memory here and never stored as a record — build_granularity (preindex.py:246) decomposes the tree into a derived summary (counts + a flat path→E map) and the code comment states consumers RE-COMPUTE it from the tree rather than read the JSON, so the honest verb is writes/creates, not persists.
audit's main loads the map into a ProjectModel and feeds the typed object to audit_model/l2_worklist_model — the entity type itself is consumed, not a pre-extracted field.
balance's main loads a ProjectModel and passes the typed object to the report/proposal functions.
the anchored line constructs the Proposal list that the split report returns/prints; 'emits' = produced as advisory output, nothing is stored.
validate's main loads a ProjectModel and passes the typed object to validate_model().
_parse_name_status constructs Change records from git name-status output at the anchored line (in-memory creation; nothing persisted).
parse_u0 constructs the ParsedDiff it fills and returns at the anchored line.
the flush() closure constructs Hunk(...) and appends it to the ParsedDiff at the anchored line.
frame_from_two_diffs constructs the FileFrame and mutates its fields (affected/insertions/whitespace_only/fully_deleted) before returning it.
_ref constructs AnchorRef (also at 188 for dir anchors) — the seed set anchor_index builds from the map.
resolve_hits constructs DirectHit and appends it to the returned list at the anchored line.
compute_impact constructs ImpactFile per change and then sets its frame/hits fields.
compute_impact constructs the ImpactCore it fills (files/warnings) and returns.
build_impact_result holds the RippleOptions object itself (typed param at :161, defaulted at :166) and branches on opts.reads/opts.callgraph/opts.callgraph_depth.
_Maps iterates model.edges — the Edge dataclass instances themselves — and classifies each by ed.src/ed.verb/ed.dst into the ownership/read/adjacency tables.
_Maps iterates model.flows (Flow objects), expanding each flow's steps and its uc into the ucs_of/pair_ucs tables.
register_ripple constructs _Impact records into the impacts table (also at :191 for direct hits).
